explanation: Probe indices 0,1,3,7,… until reaching a value at least the target or an out-of-range access. Binary-search the resulting bracket, treating out-of-range positions as larger than the target. Explicit lower/upper indices avoid negative shift counts when the first probe already stops.
timeComplexity: O(log(n+1)) probes in the worst case.
attribution: Original C++ implementation and explanation authored for EPI Practice from its public native contract and repository-authored C# algorithm. Existing upstream reference files remain unchanged.
